reason: No fresh useful location in any arm. The false-highlight-only advancement condition passed vacuously and the exposed panel lost six incumbent useful locations with the standalone candidate.
email_scope: Constructed multipart EML with genuine quoted prose. Technical writing represents the body.
format_pairing: Each edited body and its control appear in both plain text and MIME formats. Groups represent underlying works.

method.scope: Same archive site with source-disjoint fresh works and separate source-exposed diagnostic works. Use real article body paragraphs in source order around the unchanged target. Evaluate both extracted plain text and controlled multipart email containers with genuine quoted prose.
method.selection: Freeze the original 36 source commitments. Replay metadata and source qualification with room for at most 10 additional byline-disjoint works, no prior outcome inputs. Select the first 12 qualified source-exposed works by a hash of the work identifier. No coverage exclusion after scoring.
method.fixture: Select up to six supported real body prose blocks nearest the exact target within the same article, minimum four. Preserve each original paragraph and its order. Non-prose or unsupported markup can create gaps. Require 100–600 original words and at most 48 native sentences. Construct one exact center replacement and a genuine quote tail per message.
method.current: First six complete native three-sentence context windows at raw probability at least .50, in source order. This benchmark compares the incumbent window rule.
method.relative: Measure exact focus and neighbor sentences in isolation. Consider only native three-sentence body contexts wholly inside a single paragraph, with focus 12–40 words and 6–65-word neighbors. Require positive isolated focus log-odds margin over both neighbors, incumbent native log odds over the fixed PEP point, and native odds at least the median of all eligible contexts in the same paragraph. Select only the uniquely largest isolated margin across body paragraphs.
method.confirmed: Require an independent checkpoint to assign at least .50 to that same exact isolated sentence, with complete token coverage. Measure only unique top-ranked candidates. No retry or alternative after rejection.
method.current_plus_confirmed: Retain incumbent windows and add the confirmed exact sentence. Report highlights in unrelated body and quoted paragraphs separately.
method.localization: Per displayed location nonwhitespace IoU at least .30 and recall at least .50 with the known edit. Also report wrong-only results, any unrelated paragraph touched, quote flags and exact target eligibility.
method.advance: Use only fresh work groups for promotion comparisons. Require either two independent added useful work groups with at least one in each generator and at most one new human flag group, or retain all current useful locations and clear at least two genuine false-flag groups. At least six eligible fresh groups and at least six admitted edits per generator are required. Formats are paired within each group.
